title: Essentials Utils Commands
description: Mod that add essentials command for Minecraft Server
body:
# Essentials Utils Commands

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.6-green) ![Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-blue) ![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-In_Development-orange)

**Essentials Utils Commands** is a Minecraft mod project that add useful command to your minecraft server.

## Current Features
### Commands

#### Home
* `/homes`
  * List all your homes.
* `/sethome [name]`
  * Create new home with [name] at your position in the dimension.
  * The [name] have to be unique.
* `/home [name]`
    * Teleport you to [name] home.
* `/delhome [name]`
    * Delete [name] home forever.
#### Gamemode
* `/gm [mode]`
  * **0:** Survival
  * **1:** Créative
  * **2:** Adventure
  * **3:** Spectator

---

* near

* tps

## Installation
1.  Install 1.20.6 version of the **Fabric Loader**.
2. Download the **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.100.8+1.20.6)** mod and place it in your `mods` folder.
3. Download **Essentials Utils Commands** `.jar` file and place it in your `mods` folder.
4. Launch the game and run !
